title: 第1章 第一案：518儿童被拐案（1）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“小朋友，吃糖吗？”

【又是这招，这是第十五个了吧？】

【是的，我记得她叫念念，当年518儿童被拐案，就属她死得最惨，找到的时候已经被折磨得看不出人形。】

念念眼睫微颤。

连带着手里拎着的破烂也发出哗啦啦的响声。

她将两只小手背在身后，抗拒看着妇人手里的糖。

这糖……有毒。

妇人和善微笑，故意将糖纸剥开，往念念鼻尖下凑。

“你闻，这糖可香可好吃了。”

糖果香甜的气息飘入念念鼻尖。

馋得念念咽了咽口水。

上一次吃糖，还是去年在福利院过年，每个小朋友都有一颗。

软软的，甜甜的……

可自从福利院倒闭后，她就再也没吃过。

弹幕看见念念的小手蠢蠢欲动。

直接在屏幕上炸开。

【不能吃！吃了就会被人贩子带走！】

【不要啊！虽然这是一档案件还原节目，但能不能不要这么真实！】

【我不敢看！！】

密密麻麻的字几乎将念念的视线完全遮挡。

念念不认识字。

但耳边的各种声音，却让她的眼神突然清明。

人贩子！

院长阿姨说她当年就是被人贩子拐走，才会找不到爸爸妈妈。

人贩子是坏蛋！

念念将自己的视线从糖果上挪开。

突然，她朝人贩子身后叫了一声：“爸爸！我在这！”

妇人慌张扭头。

下一秒就反应过来。

一个捡破烂的小丫头，哪来的爸爸？

她回身想追。

可念念已经站在警局门口朝她扮鬼脸！

妇人气急，可她总不能闯进警局抢孩子吧！

她是人贩子，可不是没脑子！

念念跑进警局，胡乱抓着一人就往外面拉。

“警察叔叔，有人贩子！快抓住她！”

李安国刚出警回来，听到念念说有坏人，愣了一秒。

随即大笑出声。

“人贩子？小朋友，是不是家里哪个亲戚和你开玩笑呢？

别怕，咱们十一区没有人贩子。”

“是真的！真的有人贩子！”

Page (1/3)

"Kid, do you want some candy?"

[This move again, this is the fifteenth move, right?】

[Yes, I remember her name was Niannian. She died the most tragic death in the 518 child abduction case. When she was found, she had been tortured to the point of losing her human form.】

Nian Nian's eyelashes trembled slightly.

Even the rags he carried in his hands made a clattering sound.

She clasped her two little hands behind her back and looked at the candy in the woman's hand.

This sugar... is poisonous.

The woman smiled kindly, deliberately peeled off the candy wrapper and put it under the tip of Nian Nian's nose.

"Smell it, this candy is fragrant and delicious."

The sweet scent of candy drifted into Nian Nian's nose.

He was so greedy that he swallowed his saliva.

The last time I had candy was during the New Year celebrations in the welfare home last year. Every child had one.

Soft, sweet...

But since the orphanage closed down, she has never eaten again.

The barrage saw Nian Nian's little hand ready to move.

Exploded directly on the screen.

【Can’t eat it!If you eat it, you will be taken away by traffickers!】

【No!Although this is a program restored from archives, can it not be so real?】

【I dare not look!!】

The densely packed words almost completely blocked Nian Nian's sight.

Nian Nian doesn’t know the words.

But the various sounds in her ears made her eyes suddenly clear.

Human traffickers!

The dean's aunt said that she was abducted by human traffickers and could not find her parents.

Traffickers are bad guys!

Nian Nian took her eyes away from the candy.

Suddenly, she shouted behind the trafficker: "Dad! I'm here!"

The woman turned around in panic.

He reacted in the next second.

A little girl who picks up rags, where does her father come from?

She turned around to chase him.

But Nian Nian was already standing at the door of the police station making faces at her!

The woman was furious, but she couldn't break into the police station and snatch the child!

She is a human trafficker, but she is not brainless!

Nian Nian ran into the police station, grabbed someone randomly and pulled him outside.

"Police uncle, there is a trafficker! Catch her quickly!"

Li Anguo had just returned from the police and was stunned for a second when he heard Niannian say there were bad guys.

Then he laughed out loud.

"Human trafficker? My dear, is one of your relatives joking with you?

Don't be afraid, there are no human traffickers in District 11."

"It's true! There are real traffickers!"
